# Version 4.150.1
> **Skia m150 reliability fixes** · Released July 14, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.1) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.1)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.1/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.1 incorporates two upstream Skia m150 reliability fixes. The servicing update corrects corrupt text-buffer cleanup and validates clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Corrupt Slug cleanup no longer risks invalid frees** — Skia now guarantees safe destruction order when deserializing a corrupt Slug buffer. ([#4379](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4379))
- **Clipped render-pass stencil bounds are checked** — Rendering now checks clipped render-pass bounds against the stencil area that was cleared. ([#4429](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4429))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.1

HarfBuzzSharp advances from 14.2.1 to 14.2.1.1 alongside this SkiaSharp servicing release.
